# ImageLoader

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Parses JPEG and PNG metadata from bytes or a platform-supported file path.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ImageLoader()
```

## Properties

- [`maxPixels`](#maxpixels): Largest image the loader will decode, in pixels (width x height).

### `maxPixels`

```typescript
static maxPixels: number
```

*static*

Largest image the loader will decode, in pixels (width x height). An image above it is refused with an [`ImageDecodeError`](image-decode-error.md) before any pixel data is inflated, so a small file that declares enormous dimensions cannot exhaust memory. The default of 100 million pixels is about 10,000 x 10,000; raise it for large-format print work.

## Methods

- [`load`](#load): Loads and parses an image from a file on platforms with synchronous file I/O.
- [`loadFromBytes`](#loadfrombytes): Parses a JPEG or PNG image from bytes, detecting the format from its signature.
- [`loadFromBytesAsync`](#loadfrombytesasync): Async counterpart to `loadFromBytes`.
- [`loadJpeg`](#loadjpeg): Parses a JPEG image from bytes.
- [`loadPng`](#loadpng): Parses a PNG image from bytes.
- [`loadPngAsync`](#loadpngasync): Async PNG loader that uses `DecompressionStream` for inflate, so it handles Huffman-compressed IDAT chunks - i.e. every PNG exported from a real image editor.

### `load`

```typescript
load(filePath: string): ImageInfo
```

*static*

Loads and parses an image from a file on platforms with synchronous file I/O.

### `loadFromBytes`

```typescript
loadFromBytes(data: Uint8Array): ImageInfo
```

*static*

Parses a JPEG or PNG image from bytes, detecting the format from its signature. Throws for any other format. PNG data must use stored deflate blocks only; use `loadFromBytesAsync` for ordinary PNG files.

### `loadFromBytesAsync`

```typescript
loadFromBytesAsync(data: Uint8Array): Promise<ImageInfo>
```

*static*

Async counterpart to `loadFromBytes`.  For JPEGs the two paths are equivalent (no decompression needed).  For PNGs this path uses the runtime's built-in `DecompressionStream('deflate')` to inflate IDAT data, which handles every real-world PNG - the sync path only supports the stored-block subset and throws on Huffman-compressed streams.

### `loadJpeg`

```typescript
loadJpeg(data: Uint8Array): ImageInfo
```

*static*

Parses a JPEG image from bytes.

### `loadPng`

```typescript
loadPng(data: Uint8Array): ImageInfo
```

*static*

Parses a PNG image from bytes. Supports stored deflate blocks only; use `loadPngAsync` for ordinary PNG files.

### `loadPngAsync`

```typescript
loadPngAsync(data: Uint8Array): Promise<ImageInfo>
```

*static*

Async PNG loader that uses `DecompressionStream` for inflate, so it handles Huffman-compressed IDAT chunks - i.e. every PNG exported from a real image editor.  Prefer this over `loadPng` unless the input is known to use stored deflate blocks only.
